from pathlib import Path
import json, sqlite3
T='BUILDPLAN-f13331a398cbc3d1890411e1c35abdae'
h=Path.home(); r=h/'prediction_research_prod'/'knowledge'/'codex_runtime'
db=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{r/'runtime.sqlite'}?mode=ro",uri=True)
try:
 row=db.execute('select id,body,status,attempt,thread,run from tasks where id=?',(T,)).fetchone()
finally: db.close()
print('TASK_ROW='+json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False))
for p in sorted((r/'runs').glob(T+'-*')):
 print('RUN_DIR='+str(p))
 for name in ('CANDIDATE_REJECTED.json','COMPLETE.json','FAILED.json','result.json','events.jsonl'):
  f=p/name
  if not f.exists(): continue
  print('FILE='+str(f))
  txt=f.read_text(errors='replace')
  if name=='events.jsonl':
   lines=txt.splitlines()[-12:]
   print('EVENT_TAIL='+json.dumps(lines,ensure_ascii=False))
  else:
   print('CONTENT='+txt[:12000])
